g.text: Every agent turn takes seconds; ask one agent at a time and the user gives up before the plan is ready.
Three round trips: you wait for the network three times
A round trip is never free:
· about 0.5 ms inside a data center
· vs. about 100 ns for a memory read
Fix: cache what you can; make fewer, coarser calls
asks one agent at a time
(1) one agent after another: the seconds add up
(2) each task split into two small questions
(3) no deadline passed down: the agents keep working
Fix: one message per task, independent tasks in parallel
(ready at 10 s), and the deadline passed down.
